<style>
.cs-hero .w-dyn-bind-empty,.cs-body .w-dyn-bind-empty,.cs-next .w-dyn-bind-empty{display:none!important}
.cs-hero_title-wrap:has(h1.is-v2:not(.w-dyn-bind-empty)) h1.is-legacy{display:none}
.cs-hero h1 .cs-hl{display:table;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.cs-stat:has(.cs-stat_value.w-dyn-bind-empty){display:none}
/* Stats: Stat 3 filled = Stat 1, Stat 2, Stat 3 (is-v2 row). Stat 3 empty = Stat 1, Stat 2, Industry (is-legacy row). */
.cs-stats:has(.cs-stat.is-v2:nth-child(3 of .is-v2) .cs-stat_value:not(.w-dyn-bind-empty)) .cs-stat.is-legacy{display:none}
.cs-stats:not(:has(.cs-stat.is-v2:nth-child(3 of .is-v2) .cs-stat_value:not(.w-dyn-bind-empty))) .cs-stat.is-v2{display:none}
.cs-shot{-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.cs-shot.is-side:has(.cs-shot_img.w-dyn-bind-empty){display:none}
.cs-shots:not(:has(.cs-shot.is-center .cs-shot_img:not(.w-dyn-bind-empty))){display:none}
.cs-shot_screen:has(.cs-shot_img:not(.is-legacy):not(.w-dyn-bind-empty)) .cs-shot_img.is-legacy{display:none}
/* Hero screenshots: the three take turns in the middle (script in the page footer). The middle one is always in the raised,
   full-colour state. The row keeps the middle one's height (--cs-shot-h, set by the script) while they swap, so the page never jumps. */
.cs-shots.is-carousel{position:relative;min-height:var(--cs-shot-h,auto)}
.cs-shots.is-carousel .cs-shot{position:relative;z-index:1}
.cs-shots.is-carousel .cs-shot_screen{transition:opacity .6s ease}
.cs-shots.is-moving .cs-shot{transition:width .8s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1),height .8s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1),transform .8s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1),opacity .6s ease}
.cs-shots.is-measure .cs-shot{transition:width .8s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1),height .8s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)}
.cs-shots.is-carousel .cs-shot.cs-shot_ghost{position:absolute;z-index:0;margin:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .5s ease}

.cs-hero_btn:focus-visible,.cs-next_all:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #5bd3a9;outline-offset:4px}
.cs-quote:has(.cs-quote_text.w-dyn-bind-empty){display:none}
.cs-quote_text{text-wrap:balance}
.cs-quote_text:before{content:"\201C"}
.cs-quote_text:after{content:"\201D"}
.cs-quote_author:has(.cs-quote_sig.w-dyn-bind-empty) .cs-quote_divider{display:none}
.cs-block:not(:has(.cs-rich:not(.w-dyn-bind-empty))){display:none}
.cs-copy:not(:has(.cs-rich:not(.w-dyn-bind-empty))){display:none}
.cs-gallery_card:has(img.w-dyn-bind-empty){display:none}
.cs-gallery:not(:has(.cs-gallery_card img:not(.w-dyn-bind-empty))){display:none}
.cs-rich>:first-child{margin-top:0}
.cs-rich>:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.cs-rich p{margin:0}
.cs-rich p+p,.cs-rich p+ul,.cs-rich p+ol,.cs-rich ul+p,.cs-rich ol+p,.cs-rich blockquote+p,.cs-rich figure+p{margin-top:1.5em}
.cs-rich strong,.cs-rich b{font-weight:500;color:#0d1928}
.cs-rich em{font-style:italic}
.cs-rich a{color:#0d1928;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.cs-rich h2,.cs-rich h3,.cs-rich h4,.cs-rich h5,.cs-rich h6{margin:1.6em 0 .6em;color:#0d1928;font-weight:500;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.cs-rich h2{font-size:1.5em}.cs-rich h3{font-size:1.3em}.cs-rich h4,.cs-rich h5,.cs-rich h6{font-size:1.1em}
.cs-rich ul,.cs-rich ol{margin:0;padding-left:0;list-style:none}
.cs-rich li{position:relative;padding-left:1.5em;margin-top:.67em}
.cs-rich li:first-child{margin-top:0}
.cs-rich ul>li:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:.15em;top:.55em;width:.5em;height:.5em;border-radius:50%;background-color:#5bd3a9}
.cs-rich ol{counter-reset:csol}
.cs-rich ol>li{counter-increment:csol}
.cs-rich ol>li:before{content:counter(csol) ".";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;color:#0d1928;font-weight:500}
.cs-rich blockquote{margin:1.5em 0;padding:0 0 0 .9em;border-left:3px solid #5bd3a9;font-size:1em;line-height:1.5;color:#0d1928}
.cs-rich figure{margin:1.5em 0;max-width:100%}
.cs-rich figure img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:16px}
.cs-rich figcaption{margin-top:.6em;font-size:.7em;color:rgba(13,25,40,.5);text-align:center}
/* Arrow: same hover as Home (mint circle, white arrow) */
.cs-next_arrow{transition:background-color .3s,border-color .3s,color .3s}
.cs-next_all:hover .cs-next_arrow,.cs-next_all:focus-visible .cs-next_arrow{background-color:#5bd3a9;border-color:#5bd3a9;color:#fff}
.cs-next_grid:not(.is-ready)>.cs-next_item:nth-child(n+3){display:none}
.cs-next_item:has(.work-card_bg.w-dyn-bind-empty):has(.work-card_img.w-dyn-bind-empty){display:none}
@media (min-width:992px) and (max-width:1279px){
.cs-hero h1{font-size:68px}
.cs-stat_value{font-size:28px}
.cs-stat_label{font-size:16px}
.cs-hero_btn{padding-left:32px;padding-right:32px}
.cs-shot{width:420px;height:340px}
.cs-shot.is-center{width:540px;height:405px}

}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.cs-hero_btn,.cs-next_arrow,.cs-shots.is-carousel .cs-shot,.cs-shots.is-carousel .cs-shot_screen{transition:none}}
</style>
<style>
/* Work card thumbnail (same as Our Work grid, nues-work-grid): Card background + the site (Hero screen center) as a window rising from the bottom edge.
   Hover opens the window to the full preview and scrolls the homepage. No screenshot = 'Launching soon'. No Card background = old Main Image card. */
.work-card_media{container-type:inline-size}
.work-card_window{border-radius:1.95cqw 1.95cqw 0 0;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(16,25,39,.06),0 2.4cqw 6cqw -2cqw rgba(16,25,39,.28);transition:left .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),right .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),top .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),bottom .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),border-radius .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.work-card_shot{transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
@media (hover:hover){.work-card_component:hover .work-card_window{left:0;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;border-radius:0}
/* the site scrolls at an even pace whatever its length (--shot-y / --shot-dur from the script: about 500px a second, 3 to 12s); a short screenshot stays put; leaving glides back up */
.work-card_component:hover .work-card_shot{transform:translateY(var(--shot-y,min(0px,calc(-100% + 62.5cqw))));transition:transform var(--shot-dur,4s) cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) .35s}}
.work-card_bg.w-dyn-bind-empty,.work-card_window:has(.work-card_shot.w-dyn-bind-empty),.work-card_media:has(.work-card_shot:not(.w-dyn-bind-empty)) .work-card_soon,
.work-card_media:has(.work-card_bg.w-dyn-bind-empty) :is(.work-card_window,.work-card_soon),.work-card_media:has(.work-card_bg:not(.w-dyn-bind-empty)) .work-card_img{display:none}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.work-card_window,.work-card_shot{transition:none}.work-card_component:hover .work-card_shot{transform:none}}
</style>
<style>
/* Sidebar (nues-case-sidebar-scroll.html): Services used + On this page in a rail beside the text. Team (Figma 8428:1356).
   Layout and sizes are native classes; this adds the states. Colours: service colours by Services slug, circle by Discipline. */
.cs-body{overflow-x:clip}
.section_cs-team:not(:has(.cs-team_item)),.cs-used:not(:has(.cs-used_item)){display:none}
.section_cs-team .w-dyn-empty,.cs-used .w-dyn-empty{display:none}
/* the rail stops at the gallery, rides up with the page and slides out to the right; comes back the same way (script in the footer) */
.cs-aside_inner.is-away{transform:translateX(var(--off,110vw));pointer-events:none;transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.55,0,.75,.2)}
/* Services used: grey icons and text until hover, then the service colours; each icon moves in its own way */
.cs-used_item:first-child{border-top:0}
.cs-used_row{--k1:#e4e2dc;--k2:#d2cfc8;--k3:#bdb9b1;--c1:#d2cfc8;--c2:#8d929c;--c3:#0e1726}
.cs-used_row[data-svc="design-development"]{--c1:#cfe7d7;--c2:#8cc6a0;--c3:#3f7a55}
.cs-used_row[data-svc="webflow-development"]{--c1:#d5daf4;--c2:#a9b2ea;--c3:#4e5eab}
.cs-used_row[data-svc="seo-aeo"]{--c1:#f1e1c8;--c2:#d9b27a;--c3:#a86a1c}
.cs-used_row[data-svc="growth"]{--c1:#f1d3e4;--c2:#d98ab8;--c3:#a8407f}
.cs-used_svg{flex:none;display:block;width:30px;height:30px;overflow:visible}
.cs-used_svg *{transition:fill .45s ease,transform .6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),opacity .4s;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
.cs-used_svg .k1{fill:var(--k1)}.cs-used_svg .k2{fill:var(--k2)}.cs-used_svg .k3{fill:var(--k3)}
.cs-used_icon{filter:grayscale(1);opacity:.5;transition:filter .45s ease,opacity .45s ease}
.cs-used_row:is(:hover,:focus-visible){color:#0e1726}
.cs-used_row:is(:hover,:focus-visible) .cs-used_icon{filter:none;opacity:1}
.cs-used_row:is(:hover,:focus-visible) .k1{fill:var(--c1)}.cs-used_row:is(:hover,:focus-visible) .k2{fill:var(--c2)}.cs-used_row:is(:hover,:focus-visible) .k3{fill:var(--c3)}
.cs-used_row:is(:hover,:focus-visible) .cs-used_arrow{transform:translateX(3px);color:#fff;background-color:var(--c3);box-shadow:none}
.cs-used_row[data-svc="design-development"]:hover .k1{transform:scale(1.18)}.cs-used_row[data-svc="design-development"]:hover .k2{transform:scale(1.1);transition-delay:.05s}.cs-used_row[data-svc="design-development"]:hover .k3{transform:scale(.86);transition-delay:.1s}
.cs-used_row[data-svc="webflow-development"]:hover .k1{transform:rotate(-14deg) translateX(-2px)}.cs-used_row[data-svc="webflow-development"]:hover .k2{transform:rotate(12deg) translateX(2px)}.cs-used_row[data-svc="webflow-development"]:hover .k3{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.cs-used_row[data-svc="seo-aeo"] .cs-used_svg *{transform-origin:50% 100%}
.cs-used_row[data-svc="seo-aeo"]:hover .k1{transform:scaleY(1.25)}.cs-used_row[data-svc="seo-aeo"]:hover .k2{transform:scaleY(1.18);transition-delay:.06s}.cs-used_row[data-svc="seo-aeo"]:hover .k3{transform:scaleY(1.1);transition-delay:.12s}
.cs-used_row[data-svc="growth"]:hover .k1{transform:scale(1.16) rotate(45deg)}.cs-used_row[data-svc="growth"]:hover .k2{transform:scale(1.08);transition-delay:.05s}.cs-used_row[data-svc="growth"]:hover .k3{transform:rotate(90deg);transition-delay:.1s}
.cs-used_row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #5bd3a9;outline-offset:3px;border-radius:10px}
.cs-used_row:is([href="#"],:not([href])) .cs-used_arrow{display:none}
/* On this page: dark card, the active heading gets the mint line */
.cs-toc_link:hover{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8)}
.cs-toc_link.is-active{color:#fff;border-left-color:#5bd3a9}
.cs-toc_link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #5bd3a9;outline-offset:2px}
.cs-block>h2{scroll-margin-top:120px}
@media (max-width:991px){.cs-block>h2{scroll-margin-top:90px}}
/* Team: circle colour from the member's Discipline; on hover the photo fades and the LinkedIn mark comes in */
.cs-team_photo-wrap[data-discipline="development" i]{background-color:#9fb4f2}
.cs-team_photo-wrap[data-discipline="design" i]{background-color:#5bd3a9}
.cs-team_photo-wrap[data-discipline="growth" i]{background-color:#f434a3}
.cs-team_card:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #5bd3a9;outline-offset:6px;border-radius:12px}
.cs-team_card:focus-visible .cs-team_photo{opacity:0}
.cs-team_card:focus-visible .cs-team_linkedin{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}
.cs-team_card:is([href="#"],:not([href])) .cs-team_linkedin{display:none}
@media (hover:hover){
.cs-team_card[href]:not([href="#"]):hover .cs-team_photo{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) scale(1.06)}
.cs-team_card[href]:not([href="#"]):hover .cs-team_linkedin{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.cs-aside_inner,.cs-aside_inner.is-away,.cs-used_row,.cs-used_arrow,.cs-used_icon,.cs-used_svg *,.cs-toc_link,.cs-team_photo,.cs-team_linkedin{transition:none}}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
function ready(fn){if(document.readyState!=='loading'){fn();}else{document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',fn);}}
var ZW=new RegExp('['+String.fromCharCode(8203)+'-'+String.fromCharCode(8205)+String.fromCharCode(65279)+String.fromCharCode(160)+']','g');
function txt(el){return el?el.textContent.replace(ZW,'').trim():'';}
function noSlash(s){s=s||'';while(s.length>1&&s.charAt(s.length-1)==='/'){s=s.slice(0,-1);}return s;}
function isEmpty(el){return !el||el.classList.contains('w-dyn-bind-empty')||!txt(el).length;}
function imgEmpty(el){return !el||el.classList.contains('w-dyn-bind-empty')||!el.getAttribute('src');}
function rm(el){if(el&&el.parentNode){el.parentNode.removeChild(el);}}
function each(root,sel,fn){Array.prototype.forEach.call((root||document).querySelectorAll(sel),fn);}
ready(function(){
var hero=document.querySelector('.cs-hero');
if(hero){
var v2=hero.querySelector('h1.is-v2'),lg=hero.querySelector('h1.is-legacy');
// Title: Case title (is-legacy h1); the is-v2 h1 only shows old Hero title text. Case title highlight works on both.
var h1=null;
if(v2&&!isEmpty(v2)){rm(lg);h1=v2;}
else{rm(v2);if(lg&&isEmpty(lg)){var nm=(lg.getAttribute('data-name')||'').trim();if(nm){lg.textContent=nm;lg.classList.remove('w-dyn-bind-empty');}}else{h1=lg;}}
if(h1){
var hl=(h1.getAttribute('data-hl')||'').trim(),t=h1.textContent,i=hl?t.lastIndexOf(hl):-1;
if(i>-1){
var before=t.slice(0,i).trim(),after=t.slice(i+hl.length),span=document.createElement('span');
span.className='text-gradient is-green cs-hl';span.textContent=hl;
h1.textContent=before?before+' ':'';h1.appendChild(span);
if(after){h1.appendChild(document.createTextNode(after));}
}
}
var stats=hero.querySelector('.cs-stats');
if(stats){
// Stat 3 filled = Stat 1, Stat 2, Stat 3 (is-v2 row); Stat 3 empty = Stat 1, Stat 2, Industry (is-legacy row)
var v2s=stats.querySelectorAll('.cs-stat.is-v2'),s3=v2s.length>2?v2s[2]:null;
var hasV2=!!(s3&&!isEmpty(s3.querySelector('.cs-stat_value')));
each(stats,'.cs-stat',function(s){
if(isEmpty(s.querySelector('.cs-stat_value'))||(hasV2&&s.classList.contains('is-legacy'))||(!hasV2&&s.classList.contains('is-v2'))){rm(s);return;}
var l=s.querySelector('.cs-stat_label');if(isEmpty(l)){rm(l);}
});
if(!stats.querySelector('.cs-stat')){rm(hero.querySelector('.cs-stats_clip'));}
}
var btn=hero.querySelector('.cs-hero_btn');
if(btn){var h=btn.getAttribute('href');if(!h||h==='#'||btn.classList.contains('w-dyn-bind-empty')){rm(btn);}else{btn.setAttribute('target','_blank');btn.setAttribute('rel','noopener');}}
var bar=hero.querySelector('.cs-hero_bar');
if(bar&&!bar.querySelector('.cs-stat,.cs-hero_btn')){rm(bar);}
each(hero,'.cs-shot',function(shot){
var v=null,l=null;
each(shot,'.cs-shot_img',function(im){if(im.classList.contains('is-legacy')){l=im;}else{v=im;}});
if(!imgEmpty(v)){rm(l);}else{rm(v);if(imgEmpty(l)){rm(l);shot.setAttribute('data-empty','1');}}
});
var center=hero.querySelector('.cs-shot.is-center');
if(!center||center.getAttribute('data-empty')){rm(hero.querySelector('.cs-shots'));}
else{each(hero,'.cs-shot[data-empty]',rm);}
var logo=hero.querySelector('.cs-hero_logo');
if(imgEmpty(logo)){rm(hero.querySelector('.cs-hero_logo-wrap'));}
if(!hero.querySelector('.cs-shots')){hero.style.paddingBottom='clamp(64px,8vw,100px)';var hb=hero.querySelector('.cs-hero_bottom');if(hb&&!hb.querySelector('.cs-hero_bar')){rm(hb);}}
}
var q=document.querySelector('.cs-quote');
if(q){
if(isEmpty(q.querySelector('.cs-quote_text'))){rm(q);}
else{
['.cs-quote_sig','.cs-quote_name','.cs-quote_role'].forEach(function(s){var e=q.querySelector(s);if(isEmpty(e)){rm(e);}});
if(!q.querySelector('.cs-quote_sig')||!q.querySelector('.cs-quote_name,.cs-quote_role')){rm(q.querySelector('.cs-quote_divider'));}
var au=q.querySelector('.cs-quote_author');if(au&&!au.querySelector('p')){rm(au);}
var ic=q.querySelector('.cs-quote_icon.is-client');if(imgEmpty(ic)){rm(ic);}
}
}
each(document,'.cs-rich',function(r){
each(r,'p',function(p){if(!p.querySelector('img,iframe,video')&&!txt(p).length){rm(p);}});
if(r.classList.contains('w-dyn-bind-empty')||(!txt(r).length&&!r.querySelector('img,iframe,video'))){rm(r);}
});
each(document,'.cs-block',function(b){if(!b.querySelector('.cs-rich')){rm(b);}});
each(document,'.cs-copy',function(c){if(!c.querySelector('.cs-block')){rm(c);}});
var g=document.querySelector('.cs-gallery');
if(g){
each(g,'.cs-gallery_card',function(c){if(imgEmpty(c.querySelector('img'))){rm(c);}});
if(!g.querySelector('.cs-gallery_card')){rm(g);}
}
var bd=document.querySelector('.cs-body');
if(bd&&!bd.querySelector('.cs-quote,.cs-copy,.cs-gallery')){rm(bd);}
var grid=document.querySelector('.cs-next_grid');
if(grid){
var MAX=2,path=noSlash(location.pathname),curSlug=path.split('/').pop(),items=[].slice.call(grid.querySelectorAll('.cs-next_item')),cur=-1;
items.forEach(function(it,idx){
var a=it.querySelector('.work-card_component');if(!a){return;}
var slug=(a.getAttribute('data-slug')||'').trim(),href=a.getAttribute('href')||'';
if(slug&&(!href||href.charAt(0)==='#')){a.setAttribute('href','/our-work/'+slug);}
if(slug){if(slug===curSlug){cur=idx;}}
else if(href&&href.charAt(0)!=='#'&&noSlash(a.pathname)===path){cur=idx;}
});
var ordered=cur>-1?items.slice(cur+1).concat(items.slice(0,cur)):items,shown=0,keep=[];
ordered.forEach(function(it){
if(shown<MAX&&(!imgEmpty(it.querySelector('.work-card_bg'))||!imgEmpty(it.querySelector('.work-card_img')))){
grid.appendChild(it);keep.push(it);shown++;
if(isEmpty(it.querySelector('.work-card_value'))){rm(it.querySelector('.work-card_stat'));}
else if(isEmpty(it.querySelector('.work-card_label'))){rm(it.querySelector('.work-card_label'));}
if(imgEmpty(it.querySelector('.work-card_logo'))){rm(it.querySelector('.work-card_logo-wrap'));}
if(isEmpty(it.querySelector('.work-card_industry'))){rm(it.querySelector('.work-card_industry'));}
}
});
items.forEach(function(it){if(keep.indexOf(it)<0){rm(it);}});
grid.classList.add('is-ready');
if(!shown){rm(document.querySelector('.cs-next'));}
}
});
})();
</script>
<script>
/* Hero screenshots: the three take turns in the middle every few seconds (paused while off screen). A turn only changes
   the flex order and the native is-center / is-side / is-dim classes, so sizes still come from the Designer at every breakpoint. */
(function(){
function ready(fn){if(document.readyState!=='loading'){fn();}else{document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',fn);}}
ready(function(){
var box=document.querySelector('.cs-hero .cs-shots');
if(!box){return;}
var cards=[].slice.call(box.children).filter(function(c){return c.classList.contains('cs-shot');});
if(cards.length!==3){return;}
var reduce=!!(window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches);
var slot=[0,1,2],busy=false,inView=true,timer=0,DUR=850,WAIT=4500;
function apply(){
cards.forEach(function(c,i){
var mid=slot[i]===1,s=c.querySelector('.cs-shot_screen');
c.style.order=slot[i];
c.classList.toggle('is-center',mid);
c.classList.toggle('is-side',!mid);
if(s){s.classList.toggle('is-dim',!mid);}
});
}
function shown(r){return r.width>0&&r.height>0;}
function step(dir){
if(busy){return;}
var next=slot.map(function(p){return (p-dir+3)%3;});
if(reduce){slot=next;apply();return;}
busy=true;
var host=box.getBoundingClientRect(),before=cards.map(function(c){return c.getBoundingClientRect();});
var side=cards[slot.indexOf(0)],sidesHidden=getComputedStyle(side).display==='none',ghosts=[];
var wrap=next.map(function(p,i){return Math.abs(p-slot[i])===2;});
// A card that jumps across the row, or leaves the screen (phones show only the middle one), fades out as a copy where it was
cards.forEach(function(c,i){
var r=before[i];
if(!shown(r)||!(wrap[i]||(sidesHidden&&next[i]!==1))){return;}
var g=c.cloneNode(true);
g.classList.add('cs-shot_ghost');
g.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
g.style.cssText='left:'+(r.left-host.left)+'px;top:'+(r.top-host.top)+'px;width:'+r.width+'px;height:'+r.height+'px;transform:none';
box.appendChild(g);ghosts.push(g);
});
// FLIP: switch to the new places, then start every card from where it was so it glides (sizes ease in CSS at the same pace)
box.classList.add('is-measure');
slot=next;apply();
cards.forEach(function(c){c.style.transform='none';});
var now=cards.map(function(c){return c.getBoundingClientRect();});
cards.forEach(function(c,i){
var a=now[i],b=before[i];
if(!shown(a)){c.style.transform='';return;}
if(!shown(b)||wrap[i]){c.style.transform='translateX('+(dir*60)+'px)';c.style.opacity='0';}
else{c.style.transform='translate('+(b.left-a.left)+'px,'+(b.bottom-a.bottom)+'px)';}
});
void box.offsetWidth;
box.classList.remove('is-measure');box.classList.add('is-moving');
cards.forEach(function(c){c.style.transform='';c.style.opacity='';});
ghosts.forEach(function(g){g.style.opacity='0';});
setTimeout(function(){box.classList.remove('is-moving');ghosts.forEach(function(g){if(g.parentNode){g.parentNode.removeChild(g);}});busy=false;},DUR);
}
function schedule(){
clearTimeout(timer);
if(reduce){return;}
timer=setTimeout(function(){if(inView&&!document.hidden){step(1);}schedule();},WAIT);
}
if('IntersectionObserver' in window){new IntersectionObserver(function(es){inView=es[0].isIntersecting;}).observe(box);}
// The row keeps the middle one's height during a turn; keep it current when the breakpoint changes
function measure(){if(busy){setTimeout(measure,DUR);return;}var m=cards[slot.indexOf(1)];if(m.offsetHeight){box.style.setProperty('--cs-shot-h',m.offsetHeight+'px');}}
var rt=0;window.addEventListener('resize',function(){clearTimeout(rt);rt=setTimeout(measure,150);});
box.classList.add('is-carousel');
apply();
measure();
schedule();
});
})();

<script>
/* Read next cards: same hover as the Our Work grid. On hover the site screenshot scrolls at an even pace
   (script from the Our Work page: --shot-y / --shot-dur per card). */
(function () {
  function initShots() {
    var PACE = 500, MIN = 3, MAX = 12;
    document.addEventListener('mouseover', function (e) {
      var card = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.work-card_component');
      if (!card || (e.relatedTarget && card.contains(e.relatedTarget))) return;
      var shot = card.querySelector('.work-card_shot'), media = card.querySelector('.work-card_media');
      if (!shot || !media) return;
      var w = shot.naturalWidth || shot.offsetWidth, h = shot.naturalHeight || shot.offsetHeight;
      if (!w || !h || !media.clientWidth) return;
      var dist = Math.max(0, Math.round(media.clientWidth * h / w - media.clientHeight));
      card.style.setProperty('--shot-y', -dist + 'px');
      card.style.setProperty('--shot-dur', Math.min(MAX, Math.max(MIN, dist / PACE)).toFixed(2) + 's');
    });
  }
  try { initShots(); } catch (e) { if (window.console) console.warn('cs cards', e); }
})();
</script>
<script>
/* Sidebar (nues-case-sidebar-scroll.html): animated Services used icons, On this page links with scroll spy, and the rail that
   follows the text, stops at the gallery, slides out to the right and comes back after it (desktop only).
   Team: LinkedIn links open in a new tab; a member without a profile is not a link. */
(function () {
  var d = document, w = window;
  var reduce = !!(w.matchMedia && w.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches);
  var desk = w.matchMedia ? w.matchMedia('(min-width: 992px)') : { matches: true };
  function $(s, r) { return (r || d).querySelector(s); }
  function $$(s, r) { return [].slice.call((r || d).querySelectorAll(s)); }
  function txt(el) { return el ? (el.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : ''; }
  function slug(t) { var s = t.toLowerCase(); if (s.normalize) { s = s.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, ''); } s = s.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 64); return s || 'section'; }
  function off() { return desk.matches ? 120 : 90; }
  var ICONS = {
    'design-development': '<svg class="cs-used_svg" viewBox="0 0 30 30" aria-hidden="true"><circle class="k1" cx="15" cy="15" r="14"/><circle class="k2" cx="15" cy="15" r="9.5"/><circle class="k3" cx="15" cy="15" r="5"/></svg>',
    'webflow-development': '<svg class="cs-used_svg" viewBox="0 0 30 30" aria-hidden="true"><rect class="k1" x="2" y="8" width="12" height="17" rx="3"/><rect class="k2" x="16" y="8" width="12" height="17" rx="3"/><rect class="k3" x="8" y="4" width="14" height="22" rx="3.5"/></svg>',
    'seo-aeo': '<svg class="cs-used_svg" viewBox="0 0 30 30" aria-hidden="true"><rect class="k1" x="1.5" y="16.5" width="7.5" height="12" rx="2.4"/><rect class="k2" x="11.25" y="9.75" width="7.5" height="18.75" rx="2.4"/><rect class="k3" x="21" y="2.25" width="7.5" height="26.25" rx="2.4"/></svg>',
    'growth': '<svg class="cs-used_svg" viewBox="0 0 30 30" aria-hidden="true"><g class="k1"><rect x="10" y="1" width="10" height="28" rx="3"/><rect x="1" y="10" width="28" height="10" rx="3"/></g><g class="k2"><rect x="11.5" y="5" width="7" height="20" rx="2.4"/><rect x="5" y="11.5" width="20" height="7" rx="2.4"/></g><g class="k3"><rect x="12.8" y="9" width="4.4" height="12" rx="1.6"/><rect x="9" y="12.8" width="12" height="4.4" rx="1.6"/></g></svg>'
  };

  function icons() {
    $$('.cs-used_row[data-svc]').forEach(function (row) {
      var key = (row.getAttribute('data-svc') || '').trim(), svg = ICONS[key], img = $('.cs-used_icon', row);
      if (!svg || !img || $('.cs-used_svg', row)) return;
      img.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', svg);
      img.style.display = 'none';
    });
  }

  function toc() {
    var nav = $('[data-cs-toc]'), list = nav && $('.cs-toc_list', nav);
    if (!list) return null;
    var hs = $$('.cs-block > h2').filter(function (h) { return txt(h) && h.getClientRects().length; });
    if (!hs.length) { nav.style.display = 'none'; return null; }
    var used = {}, cur = -1;
    list.textContent = '';
    var links = hs.map(function (h) {
      var id = h.id || slug(txt(h)), base = id, n = 2;
      while (used[id] || (d.getElementById(id) && d.getElementById(id) !== h)) { id = base + '-' + (n++); }
      used[id] = 1; h.id = id;
      var a = d.createElement('a'); a.className = 'cs-toc_link'; a.href = '#' + id; a.textContent = txt(h);
      a.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        w.scrollTo({ top: h.getBoundingClientRect().top + w.pageYOffset - off(), behavior: reduce ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
        if (w.history && w.history.replaceState) { w.history.replaceState(null, '', '#' + id); }
      });
      list.appendChild(a); return a;
    });
    return function spy() {
      var line = w.innerHeight * 0.35, i = 0;
      for (var k = 0; k < hs.length; k++) { if (hs[k].getBoundingClientRect().top < line) { i = k; } }
      if (i === cur) return;

      links.forEach(function (a, j) { a.classList.toggle('is-active', j === cur); if (j === cur) { a.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true'); } else { a.removeAttribute('aria-current'); } });
    };
  }

  function rail() {
    var aside = $('.cs-aside'), inner = $('.cs-aside_inner'), gal = $('.cs-body_row .cs-gallery'), GAP = 40;
    if (!aside || !inner) return null;
    function setOff() {
      var was = inner.classList.contains('is-away');
      inner.style.transition = 'none'; inner.classList.remove('is-away');
      inner.style.setProperty('--off', (w.innerWidth - inner.getBoundingClientRect().left + 24) + 'px');
      if (was) inner.classList.add('is-away');
      void inner.offsetWidth; inner.style.transition = '';
    }
    setOff();
    w.addEventListener('resize', setOff);
    return function tick() {
      if (!desk.matches || !gal || !gal.isConnected) { aside.style.transform = ''; inner.classList.remove('is-away'); return; }
      var top = parseFloat(w.getComputedStyle(aside).top) || 0, g = gal.getBoundingClientRect(), h = aside.offsetHeight;
      var room = g.top - GAP - (top + h), away = !(g.bottom < top) && room < 0;
      // never overlap the gallery: the rail stops and rides up in front of it, then slides out
      aside.style.transform = away ? 'translateY(' + room + 'px)' : '';
      inner.classList.toggle('is-away', away);
    };
  }

  function team() {
    $$('.cs-team_card').forEach(function (a) {
      var h = (a.getAttribute('href') || '').trim();
      if (!h || h === '#') { a.removeAttribute('href'); a.removeAttribute('target'); return; }
      a.setAttribute('target', '_blank'); a.setAttribute('rel', 'noopener');
      var nm = txt($('.cs-team_name', a));
      if (nm) a.setAttribute('aria-label', nm + ' on LinkedIn');
    });
  }

  function run() {
    var fns = [];
    [icons, team].forEach(function (f) { try { f(); } catch (e) { if (w.console) console.warn('cs', e); } });
    [toc, rail].forEach(function (f) { try { var t = f(); if (t) fns.push(t); } catch (e) { if (w.console) console.warn('cs', e); } });
    if (!fns.length) return;
    var busy = false;
    function all() { busy = false; fns.forEach(function (f) { f(); }); }
    w.addEventListener('scroll', function () { if (!busy) { busy = true; w.requestAnimationFrame(all); } }, { passive: true });
    w.addEventListener('resize', all, { passive: true });
    if (desk.addEventListener) { desk.addEventListener('change', all); } else if (desk.addListener) { desk.addListener(all); }
    all();
    if (w.location.hash) { var t = null; try { t = d.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(w.location.hash.slice(1))); } catch (e) {} if (t && t.matches && t.matches('.cs-block > h2')) { setTimeout(function () { w.scrollTo(0, t.getBoundingClientRect().top + w.pageYOffset - off()); }, 60); } }
  }
  if (d.readyState === 'loading') d.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', run); else run();
})();
</script>
